$doc: §23.6 / F-14 (R-8338, R-8339). F-14 measured: a defending stochastic unit fires whenever a reported contact is inside its weapons' MaxRange (StochasticFirePhase.Line, KvEntry.PHitAt = 0 past MaxRange; the rifleman's M4 Range 300 in NedTkbCatalog) - the squad that 'never fired' had been ordered to a position 400 m from the contact. The anchor 'in reach' = Red's centre past y 500 (300 m from the squad at y 200; both on x 1000). Measured: Blue sees Red at 2.25 s (500 m), Red crosses y 500 at 211.75 s, Blue's first fire line at 212.25 s, the first Red slot down at 212.25 s.

expect.name: the squad is ordered Defend by KIND: it runs the generic Defend play
it sees the attacker long before it is in reach (a reported contact)
it does not fire while the attacker is beyond its riflemen's 300 m
it FIRES once the attacker is inside 300 m (F-14)
... and its fire tells: a Red slot goes down
the defender holds: it never breaks contact
... and never leaves its position (stays within 10 m of y 200)
